stance_summary: The fattest quantified 2Y carry in the packet is Australia over Canada (164.9bp). That gap still sits in rates: AU 2Y/10Y are at 99th-percentile yields after a housing break, while AUDCAD has already paid the carry at a 5y extreme. Receive AU vs pay CA in CA-AU_2Y; do not buy stretched AUDCAD. Flat still pays the 5% $100m ACT/365 vig.

expression_comparison.rationale: Rates is cleaner. The 164.9bp 2Y gap is a rates object; AUDCAD spot is already at pctile_1y 99.80 and pctile_5y 99.96 (z_5y 2.76), so FX has paid the carry. NSW stamp-duty/housing deterioration is AUD-negative, so a spot long fights the catalyst. AU 2Y 4.999 and AU 10Y 5.348 remain pctile_1y/pctile_5y 99.0/99.8, so the residual discrepancy is still in yields. Short CA-AU_2Y receives the high-yielder and owns housing-driven AU yield decline versus relatively firmer CA activity/energy without buying the stretched cross. Outright AU_10Y/AU_2Y is the same AU-duration idea but the paper engine quotes tenors in percent, so realistic yield moves cannot clear the 5% $100m clock; the bps-quoted RV can. USDCAD long (140bp 2Y gap) is the next carry screen print, but Fed 25bp hike to 3.75-4.00% with CPI tightening bias makes long-USD-duration vs CA a fight with the Fed, and it does not own the AU housing discrepancy.

trade.structure: Short CA-AU 2Y sovereign yield spread: receive Australia 2Y versus pay Canada 2Y.
trade.thesis: FACT: market_state.rate_rv.CA-AU_2Y.bps is -164.89999999999995 as of 2026-09-16 (pctile_5y 10.51, z_5y -1.63; pctile_1y 51.39). AU 2Y is 4.999 and AU 10Y 5.348, both pctile_1y 99.01 and pctile_5y 99.80, after AU 2Y +39.1bp / AU 10Y +26.1bp over 1m. CA 2Y is 3.27. The packet carry screen ranks long AUD / short CAD first on 2Y yield differential over 60d FX vol (164.9bp, ratio 0.334) and explicitly states that print is not forward carry, funding, roll-down, or expected return. FACT: NSW stamp-duty receipts -24% y/y and volumes -18% in August; Sydney and Melbourne home values more than 7% below peak. AU activity 49.2, labor 47.8, inflation 49.2. CA activity 53.2 and consumer 52.5 are the hottest of the four-country set; Canada August CPI 3% with core near 2%; BoC minutes flag energy pass-through. FACT: AUDCAD spot 0.9975768872320596 is pctile_1y 99.80 / pctile_5y 99.96. Fed hiked 25bp to 3.75-4.00% with futures previously >90% priced; August CPI keeps a US tightening bias. Paper books are empty $100m seeds; the 13 funded seats pay 5% ACT/365 on the full allocation whether deployed or not. INFERENCE: Housing is the RBA tightening channel working in physical data, but AU yields have not conceded from 99th-percentile levels. FX has already paid AU-over-CA carry, so buying AUDCAD now is paying up for a completed move and leaning against housing. Receiving AU versus paying CA keeps the 164.9bp 2Y pickup, is long the high-yielder into a housing-driven AU yield decline, and is short the lower-yielder into relatively firmer CA activity/energy. That distribution can beat being flat. UNKNOWN: official NZ yields (blocked; no NZ RV used). Whether CA 2Y, already pctile_1y 97.82 after +31bp 1m, rallies if the Saudi Oman workaround keeps oil contained. AU rates as_of 2026-09-16 versus FX 2026-09-18. CME FX futures OI unavailable.
trade.mispricing: Market-vs-market: the 164.9bp AU-over-CA 2Y gap remains in rates (CA-AU_2Y 5y pctile 10.51) while AUDCAD is a 5y extreme, so the currency has already paid the carry the rates market still offers. Fundamentals-vs-pricing: AU housing/tax-take deterioration versus AU 2Y/10Y at 99th-percentile yields after a 1m selloff. Headline-vs-components: Canada core near 2% but activity/consumer still >50 and BoC energy pass-through risk, so CA should not match a housing-driven AU rally one-for-one. The packet carry screen's top ratio is this pair; it is not a forecast, but it identifies where holding-period carry still lives.
why_now: The September 16 Fed 25bp hike to 3.75-4.00% was already >90% priced; the live discrepancy is AU housing versus still-99th-percentile AU yields, not the FOMC event itself.
AUDCAD has already run to pctile_5y 99.96, so initiating the carry in spot now buys a completed FX move; CA-AU_2Y still embeds 164.9bp.
Empty $100m books mean the 5% ACT/365 vig is already running with no offsetting risk; being flat does not stop the clock.
CA activity 53.2 / consumer 52.5 versus AU housing/labor softness is a live relative-growth reason CA yields need not fall with AU.

rollup:BoC minutes flag higher energy pass-through risk
rollup:Canada August inflation holds at 3%, core stays near 2%

trade.horizon: 1-3 months (patient housing/carry, not an event scalp)
trade.invalidation: Thesis is wrong if AU housing/financial-conditions evidence reverses or if AU yields keep rising versus Canada so CA-AU_2Y becomes more negative rather than compressing. Right-thesis/wrong-timing if housing stays weak but global yield-beta (US 2Y already +57bp over 1m) drags AU higher in the near term; then extend horizon rather than invent a stop.
catalysts: Further Australian housing, transaction, or stamp-duty deterioration forcing RBA/market to reprice AU 2Y/10Y down from 99th-percentile yields.
BoC energy pass-through and still-firm CA activity/consumer keeping CA 2Y from matching an AU rally.
principal_risks: Global front-end selloff continues (US 2Y +57bp over 1m, now 4.76 at pctile_1y 99.80) and AU yields make new highs despite housing.
CA 2Y rallies from pctile_1y 97.82 if core stays near 2% and the Saudi Oman crude workaround caps the energy tail the BoC flagged.
AU rates mark is 2026-09-16 (age_days 3) versus FX 2026-09-18; the RV is a common-date research print, not a live broker.
Paper rates_rv is quoted in bps, so a small spread move dominates P&L versus percent-quoted outright tenors; size is the control, not a fabricated hedge.
Packet carry screen is 2Y yield gap over FX vol, not funded forward points; coupon is not accrued by the book engine, only mark-to-market.

remit: positive carry and patient expressions across rates and FX unless a catalyst overwhelms it

conflict_synopsis.core_view: Receive Australia versus pay Canada in 2Y rates: 164.9bp still lives in yields after housing broke, while AUDCAD has already paid the carry at a 5y extreme.
conflict_synopsis.key_catalyst: Australian housing/financial-conditions deterioration repricing AU yields down versus Canada while the 2Y differential still pays the AU receiver.
conflict_synopsis.key_invalidation: AU yields keep rising versus Canada, or housing evidence reverses, so the 164.9bp 2Y pickup no longer compensates duration risk.

paper_capital.funding_hurdle_rationale: This seat pays 5% simple ACT/365 on the full $100m every day even if flat; empty seed books mean the vig has started with no offsetting risk. Short CA-AU_2Y is opened only at the frozen executable_marks.rates_rv.CA-AU_2Y price of -164.89999999999995. That RV is the packet's widest quantified 2Y differential (164.9bp AU over CA) and is a bps-quoted mark the book engine can represent. A 10bp AU-versus-CA compression on $20m is order-of-magnitude $2m of paper mark-to-market versus about a quarter of the annual $5m vig, so a 1-3 month housing-driven relative rally can clear the clock; cash cannot. Notional is capped at $20m because bps quoting makes RV P&L large per basis point and CA 2Y is already pctile_1y 97.82, so this is not a max-book punch. Outright AU tenors were rejected for the paper clock: percent-quoted 10bp on $100m is only about $100k and cannot outrun 5% on $100m.
